name: Test Build Release (Godot)
description: Run a Godot 4.x project's own preflight (gdlint, gdformat, strict typing, GUT, trace), verify Conventional Commits and offline-only rules, emit the deploy-meta boundary artifact, optionally export an iOS/desktop preset on macOS, and release with big-release. Reusable workflow @v4.4.0. No deploy template yet (Godot ships via GitHub Release).
